walkthroughs.body_html: Use the two end stars of the Plough as a pointer to Polaris, the North Star. Polaris sits over the North Pole, so it shows you north.
Orion the hunter is easy to spot: three bright stars in a row make his belt. Below the belt is the Orion Nebula, a star nursery.
The Plough is an asterism — a familiar shape inside a constellation. The Summer Triangle is another one.
